name: Heterogeneous MCTS, no evaluation function (ablation)
description: heterogeneous-mcts with no evaluation function: rollouts play to the end of the game (capped at 100 rounds and the time budget) and score +1 win, -1 loss, 0 error or no winner; rollouts cut off by the time budget are not backpropagated; combat-move rollouts are epsilon-greedy only.
